t: You're on Parliament Hill, the open parkland in the south-east corner of Hampstead Heath, in north-west London. It stands 98 metres, or 322 feet, high, and it's best known for its views of the capital's skyline, so this is a good place to stop and look out across the city. The actor Owen Aaronovitch was born here in 1956. He's known for playing Jon Lindsay in Coronation Street.
